project_description: A Brown Dust 2 PC daily automation assistant project built on MaaFramework.
welcome: This is a PC development scaffold focused on validating window binding, popup handling, home-screen detection, and reward collection.
controller_windows_description: Connects to the Brown Dust 2 PC client window through the Win32 controller.
resource_cn_description: Brown Dust 2 PC Chinese UI resource pack.
task_normalize_window_description: Resize the Brown Dust 2 PC client area to 1280x720 to reduce template and click-coordinate offsets.
task_startup_description: With the game already open, identify the current screen, close common popups, and confirm the home screen.
task_rewards_description: Claim mail, sign-in, and visible daily rewards. Templates will be added incrementally.
task_daily_description: Chain home recovery, reward claiming, and later daily flows.
task_powder_description: Open equipment crafting, locate the selected N-rarity item, then repeatedly craft and auto dismantle it for powder.
task_tower_description: Keep auto battle running and move to the next floor after victory without changing formation.
task_combat_description: Reserved for fixed-stage farming. Disabled by default until the base flow is stable.
preset_mvp_description: Only run home recovery and reward claiming. Suitable for early debugging.
option_powder_equipment_description: Choose which N-rarity item to craft and auto dismantle.
option_powder_count_description: Run 1-99 rounds, or continue until materials run out.
